set_ids.description:
Each entry is a Model Set id. Validated as `uuid`, NOT `uuid4`: the
reserved All Models set is 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001, which
carries no version nibble, so a version-4 check refuses the one set every
install ships granted. An id that is not a UUID at all is a 400 from the
shared validator, like every neighbouring route.
